description.value:
At 2nd level, you channel arcane energy from your deity to fuel magical effects. You begin with two options: Divine Arcana and Channel Divinity: Preserve Life (the Life Domain's 2nd-level Channel Divinity). You use these through this feature.

Choose one effect when you use Channel Arcana, then finish a short or long rest before using it again. Effects requiring a save use your wizard spell save DC.

You may use it twice between rests at 6th level, and three times at 18th level, regaining all uses on a short or long rest.
